title: LIVEWIRE AFTER DARK
style: Industrial coastal arena rock, 130 BPM, heavy kick drum, distorted rhythmic guitar low-mid heavy, metallic percussion textures, deep sub-bass pulse in verses, explosive open power chords in chorus, gang vocal reinforcement, gritty male vocal mid-register, punchy snare with gated tail, breakdown section with bass and vocal only, final double chorus peak, abrupt power chord ending
lyrics:
[INTRO – metallic hit + kick]

[HOOK – 0:03]
Livewire after dark
Iron heart
Western coast electric
Tear the night apart

[VERSE 1]
Eighty feet
Steel frame
Offshore bones
New name

Brandon stripped
Built it back
Turned a workhorse
Into impact

[PRE-CHORUS]
When the sun drops low
Deck lights spark
That’s when Livewire
Owns the dark

[CHORUS – Explosive]
Livewire after dark
Iron heart
Engines deep
Tear the night apart

Fifty-five strong
Feel the spark
Western water
Leaves a mark

[VERSE 2]
Abrolhos dawn
Montebello ride
Fishing lines
Ocean wide

Overnight crew
Wake to blue
Live-aboard steel
Cutting through

[BREAKDOWN – drums drop]
Built it frame by frame
No borrowed flame

[FINAL CHORUS – Double length]
Livewire after dark
Full power tonight
Brandon on the bow
Everything tight

Livewire after dark
Western spark
Indian Ocean
Leaves the mark

[END – hard stop]
